item.title: Kirishima International Music Festival — Guide
item.description: The Kirishima International Music Festival is one of Japan’s most prestigious summer classical-music events, held each year (typically late July into August) in the beautiful volcanic highlands of Kirishima. Founded in the 1980s, the festival brings together renowned international and Japanese classical musicians — soloists, chamber ensembles and orchestras — for several weeks of concerts, recitals and performances at concert halls and venues in the Kirishima area, set against the backdrop of the sacred mountains and forests.
